source.description: Only the listed evolution/closure components; explicit zero density/pressure sources, no external ion heating or momentum component.

boundary.description: Periodic X and Z; periodic core Y connections, identity transform and Y-uniform fields. No physical boundary faces.

coverage.limitation: The present ExB operator suppresses transport across the radial periodic seam with bndry_flux=false. These tests audit global conservation and exchange, not fidelity of periodic-seam transport.
